integrity: Finite-state verification scripts and their stdout are included; infinite statements are established by explicit counting and temporal Fourier algebra. Source date is the 1993-03-22 first public archival model reference, not a date of this theorem.
scientific_limitations: Eventual periods only; no uniform transient-time estimate. Critical spectral exclusion is sufficient but not necessary. Small finite checks are corroboration, not the proof. Historical equivalence is not fully excluded; no independent external audit.
title: A twelve-step spectral ceiling for critical excitation on integral regular graphs
